mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower financing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that triggers central bank policy accommodation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0% for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, which together drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 index points signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of late-cycle periods with INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in residential construction permits (HOUST) over the past 3 months indicates improving housing market conditions that consistently drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to early economic signals.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with rising HOUST, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in higher interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC < -0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceed 200,000 jobs, it signals a strong labor market that may trigger inflationary pressures and tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS > 200,000, or Rank IC < -0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicates a policy response to cooling inflation, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market perceives a 'soft landing' scenario.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and falling CPIAUCSL fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
